using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Ollama.Extensions;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Ollama.UnitTests.Extensions;

public class OllamaServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaChatCompletion_WithEndpoint_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(mockLoggerFactory);

        string modelId = "test-model";
        var endpoint = new Uri("http://localhost:11434");

        // Act
        services.AddOllamaChatCompletion(modelId, endpoint);

        // Assert - Verify the factory was invoked and GetService was called
        Assert.True(mockLoggerFactory.GetServiceCalled);
        var chatService = services.BuildServiceProvider().GetKeyedService<IChatCompletionService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(chatService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaChatCompletion_WithHttpClient_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(mockLoggerFactory);

        string modelId = "test-model";
        var httpClient = new MockHttpClient();

        // Act
        services.AddOllamaChatCompletion(modelId, httpClient);

        // Assert - Verify the factory was invoked and GetService was called
        Assert.True(mockLoggerFactory.GetServiceCalled);
        var chatService = services.BuildServiceProvider().GetKeyedService<IChatCompletionService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(chatService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaChatCompletion_WithServiceId_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(mockLoggerFactory);

        string modelId = "test-model";
        var endpoint = new Uri("http://localhost:11434");
        string serviceId = "test-service";

        // Act
        services.AddOllamaChatCompletion(modelId, endpoint, serviceId);

        // Assert - Verify the factory was invoked and GetService was called
        Assert.True(mockLoggerFactory.GetServiceCalled);
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var chatService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IChatCompletionService>(serviceId);
        Assert.NotNull(chatService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaTextGeneration_WithEndpoint_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(mockLoggerFactory);

        string modelId = "test-model";
        var endpoint = new Uri("http://localhost:11434");

        // Act
        services.AddOllamaTextGeneration(modelId, endpoint);

        // Assert - Verify the factory was invoked and GetService was called
        Assert.True(mockLoggerFactory.GetServiceCalled);
    }

    private class MockLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
    {
        public bool GetServiceCalled { get; private set; }

        public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider)
        {
        }

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName)
        {
            return new MockLogger();
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
        }
    }

    private class MockLogger : ILogger
    {
        public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) where TState : notnull => null!;

        public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

        public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception, Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
        {
        }
    }

    private class MockHttpClient : HttpClient
    {
    }
}
